# Expected changes in the “Light Water” update (patch 60) on June 3rd, 2025

![Expected changes in the `Light Water` update (Patch 60) on June 3rd, 2025](/uploads/519_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Expected on June 3rd, 2025 and the next content update including the new season 21 with the title “Light Water”. The main theme here is fishing, the new cannery workbench and many balancing changes. Season 20 also ends on this day, so be sure to secure all the rewards until then.

### Index

## Fishing

To unlock the **Fishing** you have to complete the new quest “Cast off the line!” go through.  Your task is then to catch a few fish and cook fish snacks. Fishing is unlocked during the quest. After the quest, the new daily is also available for you. Numerous new rewards await you here.

![Fishing Buttons](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fishing-fishing-option-gui-buttons.jpg) 

You stand next to a body of water. If you now look at the water, you will get a new option for casting the fishing rod. Hold down the fishing button and you are in fishing mode. You can change the view here. Change the bait and cast the fishing rod.

![Fishing Guide](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fishing-fishing-how-to-guide.jpg) 

There are 3 types of lures: Ordinary, Enhanced and Super

**Common Bait** can be obtained from Captain Raymond Clark and the Fisherman, as well as from new collectors in your camp

**Improved Lures** can be obtained from the following activities: **All public events** such as: Cryptic, Scorched Earth (Queen), A Colossal Problem (Earle Wiliams), Seismic Activity (Ultacite Titan), Neurological Warfare as well as the **Caravans** in Milestone Zero.

**First-class bait** is only available in season. Possibly later in the Atom Shop. So be careful with it.

For fishing there are numerous skins in the Atom Shop and the season, as well as various floats.

There are also **various mods** for spools, hooks, floats and rods. To change the mods, you can use a **Crafting Workbench**.

The **weather** also has an influence on your catch.

Basically there are 3 different weather conditions that are relevant for fishing.

1. Clear skies
2. Rain
3. Nuke Zone / Radstorm

Not only can you use the conditions from the environment, but you can also create them yourself using a weather control station in your CAMP.

Depending on the weather conditions and the bait used, there are very different chances of catching rare fish or axolotls.

![Fish Drop Odds](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fishing-catch-rates-info.png) 

## New location

The new location **Anglers Ruh** is located right next to Valley Galleria in the far east of Appalachia. 

![New location: Anglers Ruh](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fishing-fishermans-rest-location.jpg) 

In this location you will find 3 new NPCs:

**Linda Lee:** Giant hermit crab and pet of the "Fisherman". If you give her fish bites and she is hungry, you can receive legendary weapons, armor and power armor as a reward (1-3 stars).

**The Fisherman:** Silent, strange "fish person" who likes to sharpen his knives. Here you can buy ordinary bait for fishing

**Captain Raymond Clark:** The old sailor is the most talkative of the 3 NPCs, he gives you tasks in the new quest and also provides you with the new daily. You can also buy ordinary fishing bait from him.

## Fish

There are numerous different fish that you can catch. In the table of drop chances you can already see the different categories. Depending on the bait, location and weather conditions, you can catch the following types of fish:

- Generic fish
- Common fish
- Unusual fish
- Glowing fish
- Local legends
- Axolotl
- No Fish: Scrap (10% chance with Common Kö
